body.para: Replaces the contents of fields with new values, using the rules of the FoxPro dialect. This is the FoxPro version of the REPLACE command.
<Field> WITH <eExpression>The field that must be changed and the expression with the new value. You can specify multiple fields, separated by commas.
ADDITIVEAppends the value to the existing contents of a memo field instead of replacing it. This clause can be used with a single field.
NOOPTIMIZEDisables the optimization of the FOR clause. This clause is accepted for compatibility.

When you do not specify a scope, FOR or WHILE clause, then REPLACE changes the current record only. With one of these clauses the default scope is ALL. The differences with the standard command are the ADDITIVE and IN clauses, and the fact that the variable _TALLY is set (see below).
After the command has completed, the variable _TALLY contains the number of records that were processed (1 for the single record form).
The records are locked automatically when needed, and unlocked after the field has been changed.

USE Customers
GO 10
REPLACE Name WITH "Smith", Active WITH .T.
REPLACE ALL Country WITH "NL" FOR City = "Amsterdam" IN Customers
REPLACE Notes WITH "Called today" ADDITIVE
